sources.articleTitle: Congress donations plunge 75% to Rs 130 crore in 2025-26; lowest in 3 years
Congress donations fall nearly 75%, sharpest decline in a decade

headline: Indian National Congress Reports Significant Decline In Donations
seoTitle: Congress Party Reports Sharp Drop In Annual Donations
metaDescription: The Indian National Congress reported a 75 percent decline in financial contributions for the 2025-26 fiscal year according to official records.
aiSummaryBullets: The Indian National Congress recorded a 75 percent decrease in donations during the 2025-26 fiscal year.
Financial data submitted to the Election Commission of India shows the party received 130 crore rupees in contributions.
This current figure represents the lowest annual donation total for the political organization in three years.
aiContextParagraph: The Indian National Congress has submitted its annual contribution report to the Election Commission of India, revealing a significant downturn in financial receipts. According to the disclosures, the party's donations for the 2025-26 fiscal year dropped to 130 crore rupees, marking a 75 percent decline from the previous period. This reduction is notable when compared to the 2024-25 fiscal year, during which the party reported receiving 517.39 crore rupees in similar contributions. The recent data represents the sharpest year-over-year decline for the party in a decade and constitutes the lowest funding level observed over the past three years. These financial reports are mandated as part of the regulatory requirements for political entities operating within the country, providing transparency regarding the funding sources and volume received by recognized political organizations.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained attention due to the significant financial shift reported across major national media outlets in India.
